export const toPersianDigits=input=>{const str=String(input);const map={'0':'۰','1':'۱','2':'۲','3':'۳','4':'۴','5':'۵','6':'۶','7':'۷','8':'۸','9':'۹'};return str.replace(/[0-9]/g,d=>map[d]);};export const toEnglishDigits=input=>{const map={'۰':'0','۱':'1','۲':'2','۳':'3','۴':'4','۵':'5','۶':'6','۷':'7','۸':'8','۹':'9'};return input.replace(/[۰-۹]/g,d=>map[d]||d);};// Ensures HH:mm is normalized to English digits for backend
export const normalizeTime=time=>{return toEnglishDigits(time.trim());};
